# textdata

> Comment- and byte-preserving parsers and editors for .env (dotenv) and JSONC/JSON config files in Go. Parse, read, change one value and save: every comment, blank line, key order and quote you did not touch is written back exactly. Stdlib only, fuzz-tested, with ${VAR} expansion, secret plugins (gopass, Vault, AWS) and a CLI.

textdata is open source (Apache-2.0, github.com/ubgo/textdata). It is a multi-module Go repository: import only the module you need, for example `github.com/ubgo/textdata/dotenv` or `github.com/ubgo/textdata/jsonc`.

## Docs
- [README](https://github.com/ubgo/textdata/blob/main/README.md): overview, install, quick start, modules, FAQ
- [Documentation index](https://github.com/ubgo/textdata/blob/main/docs/README.md): learning path and every guide
- [Feature index](https://github.com/ubgo/textdata/blob/main/docs/reference/features.md): every feature with its guide and example
- [dotenv](https://github.com/ubgo/textdata/blob/main/dotenv/README.md): the .env library
- [jsonc](https://github.com/ubgo/textdata/blob/main/jsonc/README.md): the JSONC and JSON library
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/ubgo/textdata/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): base module release history (each module has its own)
- [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/ubgo/textdata/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): how to contribute

## Install
- Library: `go get github.com/ubgo/textdata/dotenv@latest` or `go get github.com/ubgo/textdata/jsonc@latest`
- CLI: `go install github.com/ubgo/textdata/cmd/textdatactl@latest`
- Binaries: https://github.com/ubgo/textdata/releases
